name: lynx-release-toolchain
description: Pinned semantic-release toolchain for the release workflow. Installed with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` so every release run resolves the exact same tree. conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits is held at 10.3.0 deliberately: 10.4.0 requires conventional-changelog-writer 9, while semantic-release 25 still resolves writer 8, and the mismatch fails note generation.
